description:
FOUND s492a (Opus, 2026-09-20) as the residue of #1998.  With the circular-use
import fix, IO::Socket, IO::Socket::INET, IO::Socket::UNIX and HTTP::Tiny all
LOAD, and a loopback TCP echo through IO::Socket::INET works end to end
(scratch/s492a/probes/m4-loopback.pl: `02 echo [echo:ping]` identical to
perl).  HTTP::Tiny is ONE call short.

REPRODUCER (probed vs perl 5.40.3; the same probe file -- it forks a child
that serves one minimal HTTP response on 127.0.0.1, so it needs no network):
  HTTP::Tiny->new->get("http://127.0.0.1:$port/")
  perl: status=200 content=[hello-tiny]
  PCL:  status=599 content=[IO::Handle::blocking is not implemented under PCL
        (no fcntl)]

CAUSE: HTTP::Tiny::Handle::connect does `$fh->blocking(0)` (via
IO::Socket::INET) to drive its own select() timeout loop, and lib/IO.pm:144
croaks -- deliberately, because `blocking` needs fcntl(F_GETFL/F_SETFL) and
PCL had none.  HTTP::Tiny turns any die inside a request into a 599 pseudo
response, which is why this looks like a network failure rather than a
missing feature.

LAYER (CLAUDE.md 9a): `blocking` is IO::Handle behaviour and belongs in
lib/IO.pm, but the PRIMITIVE it needs is a core one and belongs in
cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: a way to read and set O_NONBLOCK on a handle's fd.
SBCL has it -- sb-posix:fcntl with sb-posix:f-getfl / f-setfl and
sb-posix:o-nonblock -- so the shape is a small runtime primitive (the box
model owns "what fd does this handle have") plus a two-line shim that calls
it.  perl's contract, worth probing before writing it: `blocking()` with no
argument RETURNS the current state without changing it, `blocking(0)` and
`blocking(1)` set it and return the PREVIOUS state, and the answer is 1/""
not undef.

DO NOT special-case HTTP::Tiny: the croak is generic and so must the fix be.

WHY IT MATTERS: HTTP::Tiny is core perl's HTTP client and is on the README's
module list; it is how an everyday script fetches a URL, and it is also what
CPAN clients and many modules use internally.  It is the single highest-value
item left in the everyday battery (#1994) behind #1998.

BAR: a cl/ primitive + a lib/ shim => full sweep + companion io/ leg + guard
rows (a loopback server in the guard, or -- if fork+sockets cannot be made
deterministic in a Pl/t file -- a pipe handle's blocking() round trip, with
scratch/s492a/probes/m4-loopback.pl kept as the durable end-to-end probe).
subject: EVERYDAY (HTTP::Tiny): every request fails 599 "IO::Handle::blocking is not implemented under PCL (no fcntl)" -- the last thing between PCL and working HTTP
